title: The venue becomes a network

governingQuestion: What infrastructure holds a distributed Tokyo programme together?

essay.headline: The venue becomes a network
essay.opening: Tokyo Fashion Week occupies a network, not one runway.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: The current programme repeatedly uses Shibuya Hikarie halls and also lists other sites, making the week a venue network rather than one room.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Time, address, programme type and access state are joined in the schedule interface.

sections.heading: Next / limit
sections.copy: Public records reviewed do not provide complete production drawings, power loads, staging vendors, crew credits or teardown data for every show.

essay.closing: Tokyo’s technical identity is not one gadget. It is the chain of interfaces that decides what can enter, travel, translate, trade and remain.
